# Kaique Teixeira — Scope Studios

> Creative Producer based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Photography, video production, live multi-camera broadcast production (vMix/OBS), and creative direction for brands, sports organizations, and artists.

## About

Kaique Teixeira is the founder of Scope Studios, leading productions end-to-end — from creative strategy and shot planning through capture, edit, and delivery. 5+ years of experience, 200+ productions delivered, 40+ brands and organizations served, including Adidas, Vasco da Gama, NBA School, Roberto Carlos, and Elenko Sports (a footballer career-management agency representing 100+ players).

## Services

- Photography (brand, sports, events, music & entertainment)
- Video production and content
- Live broadcast production (multi-camera, vMix/OBS)
- Creative direction and brand storytelling
- Event coverage

## Location & availability

Based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Available for productions across Brazil, and open to international opportunities in content production, creative direction, and brand storytelling.
